title: IraVoice Webhook Event
description: Canonical payload IraVoice POSTs to the configured event_url for call lifecycle events. Source: ld.epicode.in/documentation (IraVoice API 2.0.0). Ledger's webhook receiver parses this. NOTE: event_data.additionalProperties is true — events carry extra fields (dialer_ip, gateway, network_ip, direction, read/write_sampling_rate); store the raw payload alongside the typed extract.

call_uuid.description: Correlation key — matches call_ledger.call_uuid and the makecall response.

call_params.description: Echo of the makecall call_params. Stamp Starling campaign_id/contact_id here for correlation beyond call_uuid.
